meta.title: Axiom desk sign-in: login, callback, session, sign out (planned)
meta.subtitle: Planned behaviour from the desk sign-in plan (KTD1, KTD2, KTD5, KTD7, KTD8, KTD10, KTD11). Not yet implemented.

messages.label: rewrite /auth/*
messages.note: Same origin: Next rewrites() proxies /auth/* to the API, passing Set-Cookie through. Cookies stay first-party, no CORS.

messages.label: purge expired, insert pending_logins
messages.note: Row holds state, nonce, PKCE verifier; keyed by SHA-256 of a random handle; expires in 10 min.

messages.label: 303 to provider authorize
messages.note: PKCE S256, state, nonce, prompt=login, max_age=28800. Set-Cookie __Host-axiom_login. Alt: discovery unreachable -> /sign-in?error=provider_unavailable; auth not configured -> error=failed.

messages.label: authorize + MFA
messages.note: prompt=login: credentials and MFA asked every time.

messages.label: DELETE pending_logins RETURNING
messages.note: Single use, and only for the browser that started it. Alt: row missing, used or expired -> error=expired.

messages.label: POST token + GET JWKS
messages.note: Both run in a worker thread; JWKS cached. Alt: unreachable or timeout -> error=provider_unavailable.

messages.label: ID token + keys, then verified
messages.note: API verifies signature, nonce, tenant claim; amr has mfa. Alt: invalid, nonce or tenant -> error=failed; no mfa -> error=mfa_required.

messages.label: Directory has user? insert session
messages.note: Stores sha256(token) only; audit record. Alt: Directory does not know tenant and sub -> error=unknown_user.

messages.label: any failure: 303 /sign-in?error=code
messages.note: Codes: cancelled, expired, provider_unavailable, failed, mfa_required, unknown_user. Fixed codes, never provider text.

messages.label: success: 303 /desk
messages.note: Set-Cookie __Host-axiom_session (HttpOnly, Secure, Lax, 8 h absolute); login cookie cleared.

messages.label: GET /auth/me
messages.note: Server Component forwards the cookie, cache no-store. 401 -> redirect /sign-in; other failure -> desk-service-unreachable message.

messages.label: Sign out: POST /auth/logout
messages.note: Plain form POST; works without JS.

cards.title: Single-use, same browser
items: pending_logins row is deleted with RETURNING on callback
Only the browser holding __Host-axiom_login can complete it
Session token stored only as its SHA-256

cards.title: Failure exits
items: Six fixed codes; provider text never reaches the URL
